subject: English
title: 英文第40題｜nothing matters的倦怠語意
question:
Choose the best answer for blank 40.
Some students feel like nothing ______.

(A) hopes
(B) matters
(C) moves
(D) worries
passage:
【Senioritis】
Senioritis is a word for feeling lazy and having low interest at the end of the school year. Many high school seniors stop studying hard, do not finish homework on time, and often daydream in class because they feel bored. This usually happens __38__, mainly when students know their next school plans or when the end of school is near.
Senioritis changes many parts of a student's life. Students may sleep more, wake up late, and spend more time __39__ their phones or watching videos while studying less. Grades may go down, and students often feel worried because they leave homework to the last minute. Some students lose interest in clubs or sports, and teachers notice they join classwork less often.
Senioritis can make students feel low and weak. They may feel tired, nervous, or unhappy, and they sometimes fight with family or friends more often. Some students feel like nothing __40__. Even though senioritis is common, students can still deal with it. Making a simple plan, setting small goals, and __41__ can help. Also talking to teachers, friends, or family can make it easier to keep working. With these habits, students can finish their last year well, feel proud, and enjoy the end of school.
Senioritis is common for many seniors, and it shows that students __42__ ready to leave school and start a new life. With good habits and help, students can get through senioritis and finish high school successfully.

【原卷字詞註釋】senior：高中三年級學生；nervous：緊張的；goal：目標。
【本題組】只收入有紅筆訂正的40、41題；其餘空格依原閱讀保留，不新增正常答題小題。
answer: 正確答案：B。matter作動詞為重要、有關係，nothing matters表示覺得什麼都不重要、無所謂。
explanation:
本段列出疲憊、緊張、不開心等學年末倦怠表現，因此這裡是覺得什麼都不重要。nothing為單數不定代名詞，matter用現在式加s，填matters。不是說完全沒有東西在移動。

【A】hope表示希望，不合nothing希望這個情境的語意。
【B】matter作動詞為重要、有關係，nothing matters表示覺得什麼都不重要、無所謂。
【C】move表示移動或感動，不能精確表達本段學習倦怠的無力感。
【D】worry表示使人擔心或擔心，與本段覺得低落、無所謂的重點不同。
